item.title: One Injured In Molino Highway 29 Rollover Crash
item.description: One person was airlifted after a single vehicle rollover crash Wednesday morning in Molino. The 19-year old female driver of a southbound Hyundai Venue lost control, crossed the median, struck a culvert, and overturned.
